scope: Synthetic fixtures on Alpha; no live coding-service activation and no native phone run

checks.name: Root UID, ordinary public HTTPS, write outside workspace, persistent home, recovery through a new runner object, no second execution
Complete stdout and binary stderr survive bounded pagination and transient-unit cleanup
Positive timeout stops a detached descendant that ignores SIGTERM
Cancellation stops a detached descendant that ignores SIGTERM

systemdFixture.cleanup: Only the fixture's transient units were stopped and removed; durable fixture logs and receipts remain.

coverage: Uncertain launch outcomes do not trigger another execution
Worker execution claim prevents duplicate process execution
Concurrent native host jobs and timeout zero
Arbitrary argv/environment and absolute host directories
Real SQLite reopen preserves request identity, output, and terminal results
Host project and data-root resolution is pinned at admission
Native timeout and cancellation preserve signal-only exit evidence
Artifacts exceed the previous total cap and follow explicitly requested file links
Workspace revision checks and post-command refresh remain functional
Dependency-preparation retries retain identity across runtime changes
Terminal legacy commands and implicit-timeout dependency requests recover after native migration without another launch

priorFindings.finding: Cancellation stopped the worker and descendants, but a signal/pipeline race recorded reason=exit instead of reason=cancelled.
priorFindings.resolution: The worker checks its signal flag again after the child exits. A new fixture and new job IDs passed the repeated qualification; the original evidence was retained.

limitations: This qualification does not claim a deployed native migration or a ChatGPT iPhone run.
Raw output has no fixed retention cap; available host storage remains finite.
Machine failure between durable launch intent and observable service admission remains explicitly uncertain and is never silently retried.
